caption:
Your auto-reply fires in 4 seconds. The lead still goes cold.

Speed gets the text sent. The words decide if they reply.

Three parts, in order:

1. Confirm: repeat the exact job. Skip the generic greeting.

2. Clarify: one question only. Address, urgency, or timeframe.

3. Commit: a specific next step with a time attached.

Rewrite your first text today. Same three parts, your own words.

DM SCALE

#leadfollowup #speedtolead #servicebusiness #crmforcontractors #smallbusinessmarketing
rationale: Carousels currently lead saves/depth for B2B authority content, and this ships an unclaimed copy framework for the first automated text itself, distinct from every prior self-score, diagnostic, triage, ladder, and ownership model already covered.
